law.suitOrRank: Must be same suit or rank
law.higherUntilCourt: Must be higher rank; anything can follow J/Q/K
law.colourSteers: After red must be higher, after black must be lower; anything can follow a red K or black A
law.suitCycle: Must follow suits in order: hearts, clubs, diamonds, spades
law.evenRedOddBlack: Even ranks must be red, odd ranks must be black
law.colourTwoBack: Must be same colour as two cards back
law.blackClimbs: Black must be higher rank; red can follow anything
law.sameColourClimbs: Same colour as last must be higher; other colour can follow anything
law.highLowAlternate: Must alternate between high (8-K) and low (A-7)
law.courtAlternate: Must alternate between court and number cards
law.lowerUntilAce: Must be lower rank; anything can follow A
law.farApart: Must be at least three ranks apart
law.colourTwoBackDiffers: Must be opposite colour to two cards back
law.suitTwoBack: Must be same suit as two cards back
law.freshSuit: Must be different suit from both of the last two cards
law.zigzag: Must zigzag: higher after a fall, lower after a rise; anything can follow equal ranks
law.afterRedLow: After red must be 7 or lower, after black must be 8 or higher
law.heartsWild: Hearts can follow anything; other cards must be higher rank
law.sumAtMost14: Two ranks must add up to 14 or less
law.parityLock: Odds must follow odd, evens must follow even
law.withinTwoWrap: Must be within two ranks (Ace and King are neighbours)
law.suitSequence: Must follow suits in order: spades, hearts, diamonds, clubs
law.sameSuitAscender: Same suit as last must be higher; other suit of same colour must be lower; other colour can follow anything
law.redHighBlackLow: Red cards must be 8 or higher; black cards must be 7 or lower
law.royalCommand: After court must be same suit, after number must be different suit
law.rangeFlip: After high (8-K) must be other colour, after low (A-7) must be same colour
law.suitSwitcher: Must be same colour but different suit
law.suitSuperiority: Must be higher suit (clubs, diamonds, hearts, spades) or higher rank; anything can follow K of spades
law.rankSandwich: Must be between the last two ranks, or equal to one
law.colourBalance: Must not make three of the same colour in a row
law.distanceMirroring: After a rise must be same suit as two back, after a fall must be same colour; anything can follow equal ranks

elevens.noMorePairsOrFaceTriplets: No more pairs or face-card triplets can be made.
